description: The brand's AI text-mention counts over a date window grouped by type, tone and qualifier — the inputs behind the share-of-voice weighted score. Use to understand mention composition and weighting. For the positive/neutral/negative sentiment split use get_sentiment_breakdown; to read the actual mention texts use get_mention_samples. Dates must fall within the data retention window. Answers questions like "am I recommended or just listed" or "break my mentions down by type".

countries.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. "US", "GB", "DE"); a project's configured codes are listed by get_available_filters

engines.description: allowed values: chatgpt, perplexity, google_ai_overview, google_ai_mode, google_serp, google_shopping

name: get_mention_mix
title: AI mention mix (type/tone/qualifier)
